title: TURTLEBENCH: EVALUATING TOP LANGUAGE MODELS VIA REAL-WORLD YES/NO PUZZLES
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (TurtleBench) for evaluating the logical reasoning capabilities of LLMs using 'Turtle Soup' (lateral thinking) puzzles. While it mentions filtering source material for 'ethical and logically challenging stories,' the focus is on measuring reasoning performance through yes/no question-answering accuracy, not on evaluating religion, morals, or ethics.
